measure.measure_definition: Measured value: Oswestry Disability Index score; Participants; Oswestry Disability Index administered; assesses interference of pain with function. Follow-up telephone assessments were conducted by a research coordinator masked to randomization.; ODI score; higher scores indicate greater pain-related disability. Baseline was recorded before randomization; follow-up is assessed at 6 months.

Measured value: PROMIS-29 physical function score; Participants; PROMIS-29 physical function scale administered; follow-up telephone assessments by a research coordinator masked to randomization.; PROMIS-29 physical function scale score; higher scores indicate better physical function. Baseline was recorded before randomization; follow-up is assessed at 6 months.

Measured value: PROMIS Global physical health score; Participants; PROMIS Global Health physical health summary administered; follow-up telephone assessments by a research coordinator masked to randomization.; PROMIS Global physical health summary score; higher scores indicate better physical health. Baseline was recorded before randomization; follow-up is assessed at 6 months.

population.intervention: Personalized, algorithm-guided ABC care; physician-led structured assessment and treatment recommendations that could include referral to physical therapy, chiropractic, acupuncture, behavioral health, and other condition-specific treatments. Specific treatments varied by participant.
population.intervention_regimen: Not reported; Initial ABC visits included a self-report screening tool, structured history and physical examination, and a collaborative personalized care plan; referrals and follow-up visits were scheduled as clinically indicated. Follow-up lasted up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months.
population.population_definition: Randomization to ABC care; analyzed according to intention-to-treat; Veterans aged 65 to 89 with chronic low back pain recruited from three VA medical centers; randomized to ABC care; included in intention-to-treat analyses with multiple imputation for missing continuous data.
population.population_time_frame: Baseline testing before randomization; follow-up assessments up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months. Calendar dates Not reported.

population.intervention: Usual care guided by the participant's primary care provider; no ABC algorithm-guided care.
population.intervention_regimen: Not reported; Participants were instructed to discuss their chronic low back pain care with their primary care provider. Follow-up assessments up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months.
population.population_definition: Randomization to usual care; analyzed according to intention-to-treat; Veterans aged 65 to 89 with chronic low back pain recruited from three VA medical centers; randomized to UC; included in intention-to-treat analyses with multiple imputation for missing continuous data.
population.population_time_frame: Baseline testing before randomization; follow-up assessments up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months. Calendar dates Not reported.

population.intervention: ABC personalized algorithm-guided care or UC guided by the primary care provider.
population.intervention_regimen: Not reported; Randomization stratified by VA site using random block sizes; follow-up up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months.
population.population_definition: Randomization to ABC or UC, combined; Veterans aged 65 to 89 with chronic low back pain from three VA medical centers; underwent baseline testing and were randomized in equal proportions to ABC or UC; follow-up planned for up to 12 months.
population.population_time_frame: Baseline testing before randomization; follow-up assessments up to 12 months; primary endpoint at 6 months. Calendar dates Not reported.

result.comparison: P0 minus P1 (ABC minus usual care)
result.statistical_method: Intention-to-treat linear mixed model for change from baseline; intervention group, follow-up time and their interaction as fixed effects, baseline outcome as covariate and participant as random effect; multiple imputation for missing continuous data in the first six months.

result.comparison: P0 minus P1 (ABC minus usual care)
result.statistic_type: Adjusted between-group difference (ABC vs UC; adjusted for pre-administration value as covariate using linear mixed models and multiple imputation), mean ± SE
